description: The plot illustrates BLEU scores as a function of the gold-prefix length, with two series labeled “Consistency: wait-1” and “Inconsistency: wait-9” shown together for comparison. The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer values from 0 to 20 with major tick labels at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 23 to 29 with evenly spaced tick labels every 1 BLEU point. The “Consistency: wait-1” series is drawn as a blue dashed line with open circle markers at each integer x value; it begins near 24.7 at x=0, drops to around 23.7 at x=1, then generally rises across the x-axis, reaching about 26.0 around x=10–11 and continuing upward to roughly 28.1 at x=20. The “Inconsistency: wait-9” series is drawn as a red solid line with filled square markers; it starts around 25.1 at x=0, increases to roughly 25.7–25.8 by x=2–3, reaches about 26.0 around x=5–6, then fluctuates mostly between about 25.1 and 25.7 through the middle x values (with a low near 25.1 around x=14–15), and ends near 25.9 at x=20.
